description: Read or change the cook's pantry: food on hand and staples, which Befana leaves off shopping lists and uses for what-can-I-make. Use when the cook says what they have or ran out of ("I've got chicken thighs and half an onion", "we're out of eggs"), corrects it, or asks what's in it. Pass their words verbatim as text; or add/remove names; a fridge photo goes in photo (an upload name). No arguments reads it. Saying what they have is the cook's yes: save it and read the change back in one line. Never add what the cook didn't say. Returns the change (unsure lists what didn't read as food) or the whole pantry.

photo.description: An upload name (or its /media/ URL) from POST /api/upload with purpose "parse": a photo of the fridge or shelf to read

replace.description: Take out every fresh item not in this update (staples stay)

staples.description: Set the always-on-hand list to exactly these

name: pantry

age_days.description: Fresh items only: days since the cook said they had it

key.description: The canonical ingredient id, or free:<name> for an unlisted one

label.description: Befana's name for it when it matched a known ingredient, else name

note.description: A quantity or state the cook mentioned ("2 lbs", "half")

stale.description: Fresh items only: old enough to ask "still have it?"

staple.description: Always on hand; left off shopping lists

adjusted.description: Defaults this call took instead of failing (#243): an unknown units word, a number out of range, a diet word read as the closest one Befana knows. Mention it when it changes what the cook gets

asks.description: At most one question for the cook, with a home in preferences

ask_now.description: false when the response also offers a next step: the offer is the turn's one question, so don't ask this now, but save the answer if the cook volunteers it

saves_to.description: Where the answer goes, e.g. update_preferences.servings (after the cook confirms)

say.description: The question, in the cook's terms

items.description: Reading: everything on hand and the staples

age_days.description: Fresh items only: days since the cook said they had it

key.description: The canonical ingredient id, or free:<name> for an unlisted one

label.description: Befana's name for it when it matched a known ingredient, else name

note.description: A quantity or state the cook mentioned ("2 lbs", "half")

stale.description: Fresh items only: old enough to ask "still have it?"

staple.description: Always on hand; left off shopping lists

next_steps.description: What to offer next, best first. Offer the top one in one sentence; run its tool with its args if the cook says yes

action.description: What the step is, stable across releases: shopping_list, order_groceries, save, fork, draft, share, scale, show_hidden, open_recipe, pantry_update…

args.description: Arguments to pass as they are; the assistant may add what the cook says

say.description: One sentence to offer the cook, in their terms. Ending in "do it without asking" means the cook already asked for it: run it

tool.description: The tool that does it, or null when the assistant does it in conversation (e.g. sharing links)

notices.description: At most one note about Befana to pass on when there's room (one per cook per week; off with workflow whats_new: off)

say.description: One sentence to mention when the conversation has room; never more than one per turn

stale.description: Reading: fresh items old enough to ask "still have it?"

unknown.description: Changing: asked to remove, but not in the pantry

unsure.description: Changing: what didn't read as an ingredient; ask the cook

suggestion.description: "Did you mean…?" when the text is one edit from a known ingredient

title: What the cook has on hand
